ios.desc:
Here is the quickest way to see when the next train will arrive. Open up the app and instantly see upcoming trains for the nearest stations to you — no fumbling around tapping small buttons or trying to find the station on a map. Here also supports widgets and the Apple Watch, giving you even quicker access to train information.

A press on one of the platforms shows you additional upcoming arrivals and last-stop details for each train. And, the arrivals at large stations that serve many lines are intelligently organized by heading, instead of being bucketed into just two categories.

Features:
- Quick-to-access subway train information for the stations closest to you
- Beautiful home screen widgets allow you to see arrivals info for the closest station or a pinned station of your choosing
- Apple Watch and iPad support gives you the information you need on all your devices

New York City and Washington D.C. are the only regions currently supported by Here.
